lecons.title: ICT equipment
lecons.summary: I.C.T means Information and Communication Technology. ICT equipments are the various tools used for communication, and there are two types: the local or traditional tools, and the modern tools.

lecons.title: Uses of local ICT tools
lecons.summary: Each local ICT tool has its own use. The bell tells the time. The whistle is used for sports and games, and to control traffic. The talking drum and the gong are used to make an announcement.
